title: Predecessor reports are invisible across run ids: a re-run epic's first attempt still starts blind
body: tick nvn's discovery walks <ExecStateRoot>/<runID>/<tick>/<n>, so a re-dispatched attempt sees only the attempts of its own run. Re-running an epic under a new run id re-dispatches the same ticks, and those attempts are handed none of the previous run's archived reports — the exact starting-blind case the tick exists for, one level up. A discoverer keyed by tick (and optionally epic) rather than by run id, or a run-start copy-forward of the tick's predecessor list, would close it.
